points.title: Standard Stereo (artist-owned)
points.body: Standard stereo, unmixed, raw. **100% owned by the artist.** They can sell it to their heart's content infinitely if they want to perform their own mix/master. AGF takes nothing.

deep.headline: Artist Rights — artists drive their own destiny.
deep.lede: The philosophy, the three ownership tiers, how the agreement is enforced, and every revenue stream with its split.

sections.title: A vibrant, financially healthy arts community
sections.body: AGF aspires to be the catalyst, and driver of, a vibrant and financially healthy arts community. The standard stereo capture and the on-site recording belong to the artist — full stop. The patented version and broadcast-mixed version are co-owned with AGF, **50/50 in perpetuity**, and the artist retains the right to **block any subsequent broadcast by the venue, without cause**. We front-run the inevitable open-source-advocate and big-tech-smear-campaign outrage by being the most artist-favorable contract in the industry.

items.title: Standard Stereo (artist-owned)
items.body: Standard stereo, unmixed, raw. **100% owned by the artist.** They can sell it to their heart's content infinitely if they want to perform their own mix/master. AGF takes nothing.
list: Right: Full ownership of the raw stereo capture
Right: Right to mix, master, and distribute independently
Right: Right to monetize via any channel
Right: No revenue share owed to AGF
Restriction: May not represent the recording as a l'Art / patented version

items.title: l'Art Patented Version (AGF-owned)
items.body: The l'Art-encoded version is **owned by AGF** as the inventor. Distribution gated through stereOS-licensed devices and the AGF owners portal.
list: Right: Distribution through AGF owners portal
Right: Performance rights at AGF flagship venues
Right: Sub-licensing to stereOS adopters
Restriction: Cannot exist without the artist's standard-stereo capture as input
Restriction: Subject to artist blocking rights on broadcast

items.title: Broadcast-Mixed Version (50/50)
items.body: Broadcast-optimized mix that combines the captured performance with AGF's broadcast-mix engineering. **Revenue split 50/50 in perpetuity.** Artist retains right to block any subsequent broadcast by the venue, without cause.
list: Right: 50% of broadcast revenue, in perpetuity
Right: Right to block any subsequent broadcast (no cause required)
Right: Right to set fan-purchase ("forever copy") pricing
Right: Owner-portal exposure via permanent virtual all-access
Restriction: AGF retains the broadcast-mix master
Restriction: AGF retains 50% of broadcast revenue

items.title: Terms of service
items.body: If AGF can identify a device capturing patented content for illicit distribution, the user — by accepting the terms of service — is **blocked from all future business with AGF**, and legal action will be taken by AGF, on behalf of the artist, to recover proceeds from illicit marketing.

items.title: On behalf of the artist
list: Recovery of proceeds on behalf of the artist
Permanent ban from AGF hardware ecosystem
Termination of stereOS device entitlements
Civil action under the terms of service

items.title: A faux-pas, not a piracy panic
list: Bootlegging positioned as a social faux-pas (not a piracy panic)
Owner status as community-membership signal — withdrawn on violation
Artist communities surface bad actors organically

sections.title: Every stream and its split
rows: Artist sells own mix/master via any channel.
AGF distributes through owners portal and stereOS adopters.
Broadcast-optimized stereo+video, distributed through standard app platforms.
AGF hardware owners receive permanent virtual all-access. AGF either provides the venue free or forfeits its share to the venue + artists.
Artist sets pricing. Fan owns digital copy and is responsible for backup.
